title: KRISPY KREME® Celebrates the Sweetest Days of Summer with New Original Glazed® Blueberry Flavored Doughnut
summary: Available only July 23-26, get a dozen Original Glazed® Blueberry Flavored Doughnuts for just $5 with the purchase of any dozen at regular price Krispy Kreme® is celebrating peak blueberry season with the new, limited-time Original Glazed® Blueberry Flavored Doughnut – a berry delicious twist on the iconic Original Glazed® that captures the sweetest moments of summer in every bite. Available only July 23-26, get a dozen Original Glazed® Blueberry Flavored Doughnuts for just $5 with the purchase of any dozen at regular price Available for four days only – Thursday through Sunday (July 23-26) – this irresistible treat features Krispy Kreme's melt-in-your-mouth Original Glazed® doughnut made with blueberry-flavored dough, delivering a vibrant, fruity twist on a fan favorite. It's the perfect way to celebrate the sweetest stretch of National Blueberry Month before the season slips away.
